equation_summary: Per token (naive.py:52-62): S' = exp(g_t) * S_{t-1} with per-head scalar log decay; delta read uses an INDEPENDENT predict key p_t: delta = beta_t * (v_t - p_t^T S'); the write commits along a separate write key k_t: S_t = S' + k_t delta^T; o_t = (scale*q_t)^T S_t, read after update. So the retrieval/eraser key p and the write key k are distinct operands (naive.py:59 retrieves with b_p, :61 writes with b_k). Layer: beta=sigmoid, g=logsigmoid(a_proj) per head, optional q/k L2-norm in kernel, and a static per-channel decay.sigmoid() modulation p = k * sigmoid(decay) in one mode (layers/comba.py:272,281,296).
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM call graph E[dual-key projections/gates] ; B[K2 delta with independent predict/write keys] ; E[output]: the mixer takes separate p (predict) and k (write) operands and uses them asymmetrically (naive.py:56,59,61) — a dual-key delta, exactly the blocked descriptor.

CONFIRM 'Separate key gradients; no tied-key rewrite': setting p=k recovers GDN (026), but the source keeps them independent with independent projections, so VJPs for p and k must both exist and no tied-key substitution is legal.
CONFIRM blockers cover the law; the optional static per-channel p-modulation (layers/comba.py:272) is an external operand transform and needs no core change.
axis: A8 dual-key delta (independent predict/erase key and write key on the rank-1 delta update)
direction_justification: Decoupling the retrieval key from the write key is a closed typed property of the rank-1 delta update (related to GDN2's distinct erase factor) that does not collapse to the single-key U2.D law, so it is an axis with descriptor + references first.
open_questions: Whether the dual-key property should be unified with GDN2's distinct erase factor into one 'asymmetric rank-1 delta' descriptor (p plays the role of b*k in GDN2 with b implicit) or kept as separate axes.
Whether q/k L2-norm in kernel and the static decay.sigmoid() p-modulation are numerical-policy fields or external.
